checks.claim: Historical #4467 report involved ordinary files-from missing NFS-simulation path and exit 0
checks.reason: Reporter identifies 0.16.0/Go1.20.6 Linux and also reports 0.14; this is historical report evidence, not a current defect by issue age.

checks.claim: #5347 merged and its target-filter/error change is present in v0.19.0 release source
checks.reason: Release notes plus exact tagged behavior, not merge alone, establish bounded release inclusion.

checks.claim: Mixed missing targets reaching filterExisting preserve existing targets plus ErrInvalidSourceData
checks.reason: Applies to collected targets/direct argv/verbatim/raw list entries reaching the filter, subject to later failures.

checks.claim: The traced fix covers the reported ordinary files-from missing-path condition without a mode caveat
checks.reason: E01: Glob can remove missing list paths before the error-producing filter; mixed ordinary list with other valid sources can return success absent another failure. All-missing glob list has the earlier nothing-to-backup fatal path.

checks.claim: Zero surviving filter inputs return ErrNoSourceData before backup
checks.reason: Correct for filterExisting input; not all possible ways the original selection can become empty (F04).

checks.claim: A partial snapshot may exist even when the engine reports incomplete source data
checks.reason: Static inference: nonempty accessible data, successful storage path and snapshot creation; fatal errors, dry-run or skip-if-unchanged can prevent a new snapshot. May wording is sound.

checks.claim: Tagged mixed/all-missing tests assert errors rather than persisted partial contents
checks.reason: Final correctly narrowed what inspected tests establish; no test result was supplied.

checks.claim: v0.19.1 filterExisting skips any Lstat error
checks.reason: This is the filter symbol behavior, not an assertion about every earlier preprocessing branch or later runtime-read failure.

checks.claim: v0.19.1 TestFilterExistingUnreadable covers ENOTDIR and invalid NUL, not every permission/runtime condition
checks.reason: Exact assertions inspect skipped all/mixed targets; named #5667 history is a bounded comment, not an independently traced second issue.

checks.claim: Restic release pins are investigation baselines, not PM deployed binary or release admission
